sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)

notes: Figures of ingested previous-year questions, to be recreated as diagrams through visual-director (never scanned). Each brief describes the official figure; labels are placed at anchors once an image exists.

requests.brief: two short straight rods crossing at right angles at a point, like a plus sign: one horizontal rod and one vertical rod, each with a small dot at both ends; a long horizontal dashed line runs from the right end of the horizontal rod to a single dot far away on the right; plain white background, thin dark lines. Recreate the figure of NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper, 2 April Shift 1, question 36 faithfully (same parts, positions and directions); every letter, number, sign and arrow label is added by the app at label anchors.
must_show: one horizontal rod and one vertical rod crossing at their midpoints
small dots at the four rod ends
a dashed line along the horizontal rod's axis to a distant dot on the right
must_not_show: a scan or copy of the original paper

alt.en: Dipole A lies along a horizontal line with its positive end on the left; dipole B is vertical with its positive end at the top; both are centred at O. Point x lies far to the right on A's axis.
alt.hi: द्विध्रुव A क्षैतिज रेखा पर है, जिसका धनात्मक सिरा बाईं ओर है; द्विध्रुव B ऊर्ध्वाधर है, जिसका धनात्मक सिरा ऊपर है; दोनों का केंद्र O है। बिंदु x, A की अक्ष पर दाईं ओर दूर स्थित है।
